summary: Full E2E test of AUREM Dev: 10/10 backend pytest tests pass (health, auth signup/login/me, chat with Emergent LLM, stacks). Full frontend Playwright run also passes: landing (hero + CTAs + sidebar + api-online pill), signup flow with unique email, login with seeded creds, chat send + assistant reply via Emergent (reply: 'Hello to you as well!'), all 7 sidebar nav items load without runtime errors, logout clears token and redirects to /login.

issues: api-pill briefly renders 'api offline' on initial mount before /api/health resolves; cosmetic only — pill flips to 'api online' once response lands. Consider initializing health=null and rendering pill only after first response, or default-hopeful state.

critical_code_review_comments: main.py calls load_dotenv() twice (lines 16 and 36) — second call is a no-op but unnecessary. Cosmetic.

Frontend api.js: process.env access path is duplicated/legacy alongside import.meta.env — works under CRA-style env injection, but if migrated to pure Vite, the import.meta fallback is the only one wired (vite.config likely injects process.env). No bug today; flag for future migration.
Chat health pill on Dashboard initial mount shows 'api offline' for a few ms while /api/health is in flight (default state is null which fails the .ok ternary). Cosmetic.
Logout uses window.location.href — fine for now but a navigate('/login') would keep SPA history cleaner.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/* with /api/aurem-dev prefix for aurem routes. Chat uses Emergent LLM (provider returns 'emergent'). All 7 sidebar pages render.
